items.title: The Back key reaches a plugin only through PluginHost's overlay window
items.reason: a plugin view lives in a focusable overlay window, not an Activity; only that window sees the key

evidence.source: PluginHost's window flags, measured on the tablet; Image Editing device round

probe.unprobed: needs a key press on the tablet

items.title: PluginHost's file rules: a plugin writes only in its private folder and the shared MyStyle folder; picture-search's module allows only the plugin's own folders; the built-in Sticker plugin keeps its library in its own private folder, and its import lists .sticker files in the shared folders named here
items.reason: the SDK does not list the folders a plugin may write; device rounds showed the whitelist

evidence.source: device rounds (#22); packages/picture-search SafePaths; the Sticker plugin's import folders: device data (#35)

items.upgradePath: an SDK file API that names the allowed folders

probe.unprobed: #293 adds a write and delete of a test file in each allowed folder

items.title: PluginHost's plugin list provider
items.reason: no public API lists installed plugins; the provider answers the shell

items.title: PluginHost's private PluginSettingService and its binder descriptors
items.reason: no public API installs, enables or permits a plugin; the service is the only route without the screen
items.upgradePath: the screen route of inkctl (level 4) or an official install API

items.title: The transaction numbers of IPluginSetting's four calls
items.reason: the numbers come from PluginHost's interface as seen in device data; a reordered interface would run another method, so each call checks the name behind its number first
items.upgradePath: read every number from the Stub's TRANSACTION_ constants at run time (level 3)

items.title: PluginHost's PluginInfo and PluginPermission classes, loaded by reflection, and the fields set on them
items.reason: the parcel layout is PluginHost's own; loading its classes avoids copying that layout

items.title: The permission status values: -1 the lowest (cancelled), 2 Always Allow
items.reason: PluginPermissionManager's constants are private; the value was read in device data

probe.unprobed: a probe would change a plugin's permission

items.title: The host dialogs show with no activity, and showRattaDialog's isSuccess false draws the Prompt dialog
items.reason: the SDK passes getCurrentActivity(), which PluginHost leaves null; HostUIImpl swaps it for the application context (observed device behaviour); the docs do not describe isSuccess

evidence.source: PluginHost 1.00.2610150 HostUIImpl, observed device behaviour (docs/supernote.md › Ratta dialog); packages/ui-kit/native-catalog.md › Confirm dialog

items.upgradePath: an SDK dialog call documented for a plugin with no view
